author: GitHub
description:
Traditional technical certifications often require stepping away from daily projects to complete tests or multiple-choice questions. GitHub Copilot verified proficiency takes a different approach by evaluating how you already use the tool in your everyday development workflow. Without a separate exam, developers can opt in to calculate their proficiency level across five distinct tiers based on real product usage signals. Qualifying developers at the proficient level or higher can claim a Microsoft Pro Badge on Credly and showcase verified capability statements directly on LinkedIn. Explore the framework and check your proficiency at https://learn.github.com/proficiencies/copilot/
